title: चतुर्विंशतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 24 · The story of Brahma as charioteer of Shiva

summary.en: To persuade Shalya, Duryodhana tells how the gods, to destroy the three cities of the asuras, made Brahma the charioteer of Shiva's chariot. He argues that Shalya, being the equal of Krishna, should do the same for Karna, the equal of Arjuna.
summary.kn: ಶಲ್ಯನನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಸಲು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಅಸುರರ ತ್ರಿಪುರ ನಾಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನನ್ನು ಶಿವನ ರಥದ ಸಾರಥಿಯನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೃಷ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಸಮನಾದ ಶಲ್ಯ ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಗೆ ಸಮನಾದ ಕರ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ವಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शल्य को मनाने के लिए दुर्योधन कथा सुनाता है कि असुरों के त्रिपुर को नष्ट करने के लिए देवताओं ने ब्रह्मा को शिव के रथ का सारथी बनाया। वह तर्क देता है कि कृष्ण के समान शल्य को अर्जुन के समान कर्ण के लिए वैसा ही करना चाहिए।
summary.te: శల్యుని ఒప్పించడానికి దుర్యోధనుడు అసురుల త్రిపురాలను నాశనం చేయడానికి దేవతలు బ్రహ్మను శివుని రథానికి సారథిని చేసిన కథ చెబుతాడు. కృష్ణునికి సమానుడైన శల్యుడు అర్జునునికి సమానుడైన కర్ణునికి అలాగే చేయాలని వాదిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: சல்யனை இணங்கவைக்கத் துரியோதனன் அசுரர்களின் முப்புரங்களை அழிக்கத் தேவர் பிரம்மனைச் சிவனின் தேர்ச் சாரதியாக்கிய கதையைக் கூறுகிறான். கண்ணனுக்கு நிகரான சல்யன் அர்ஜுனனுக்கு நிகரான கர்ணனுக்கு அவ்வாறே செய்ய வேண்டும் என்று வாதிடுகிறான்.
summary.ml: ശല്യനെ പ്രേരിപ്പിക്കാൻ, അസുരന്മാരുടെ മൂന്നു പുരങ്ങൾ നശിപ്പിക്കാൻ ദേവന്മാർ ബ്രഹ്മാവിനെ ശിവന്റെ രഥത്തിന്റെ സാരഥിയാക്കിയ കഥ ദുര്യോധനൻ പറയുന്നു. കൃഷ്ണന്റെ തുല്യനായ ശല്യൻ, അർജുനന്റെ തുല്യനായ കർണ്ണനുവേണ്ടി അതുപോലെ ചെയ്യണമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം വാദിക്കുന്നു.

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
भूय एव तु मद्रेश यत्ते वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ।
यथा पुरा वृत्तमिदं युद्धे देवासुरे विभो ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the Madras, hear further what I will tell you, how this happened long ago in the war between the gods and the demons, O lord.

verses.text:
यदुक्तवान्पितुर्मह्यं मार्कण्डेयो महानृषिः ।
तदशेषेण ब्रुवतो मम राजर्षिसत्तम ।
त्वं निबोध न चाप्यत्र कर्तव्या ते विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: I will tell it in full as the great sage Markandeya told it to my father. Best of royal sages, understand it, and you need not hesitate over it.

verses.text:
देवानामसुराणां च महानासीत्समागमः ।
बभूव प्रथमो राजन्संग्रामस्तारकामयः ।
निर्जिताश्च तदा दैत्या दैवतैरिति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: There was a great clash of the gods and the Asuras, O king. The first battle took place over Taraka, and we have heard that the Daityas were then defeated by the gods.

verses.text:
निर्जितेषु च दैत्येषु तारकस्य सुतास्त्रयः ।
ताराक्षः कमलाक्षश्च विद्युन्माली च पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: When the Daityas were beaten, Taraka's three sons, Tarakaksha, Kamalaksha and Vidyunmalin, O king,

verses.text:
तप उग्रं समास्थाय नियमे परमे स्थिताः ।
तपसा कर्शयामासुर्देहान्स्वाञ्शत्रुतापन ॥

meaning.en: took up fierce austerity and stayed in the highest observances, wasting their bodies by austerity, O tormentor of enemies.

verses.text:
दमेन तपसा चैव नियमेन च पार्थिव ।
तेषां पितामहः प्रीतो वरदः प्रददौ वरान् ॥

meaning.en: By self-control, austerity and discipline, O king, the Grandfather was pleased with them and, granting boons, gave them what they asked.

verses.text:
अवध्यत्वं च ते राजन्सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा ।
सहिता वरयामासुः सर्वलोकपितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: Together they asked the Grandfather of all the worlds for immunity from death, always, from all beings.

verses.text:
तानब्रवीत्तदा देवो लोकानां प्रभुरीश्वरः ।
नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं हि निवर्तध्वमतोऽसुराः ।
वरमन्यं वृणीध्वं वै यादृशं संप्ररोचते ॥

meaning.en: Then the god, lord and master of the worlds, said to them, "There is no complete immortality, so turn back, Asuras. Choose another boon, whatever pleases you."

verses.text:
ततस्ते सहिता राजन्संप्रधार्यासकृद्बहु ।
सर्वलोकेश्वरं वाक्यं प्रणम्यैनमथाब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, they deliberated together many times, bowed to the lord of all worlds and said to him:

verses.text:
अस्माकं त्वं वरं देव प्रयच्छेमं पितामह ।
वयं पुराणि त्रीण्येव समास्थाय महीमिमाम् ।
विचरिष्याम लोकेऽस्मिंस्त्वत्प्रसादपुरस्कृताः ॥

meaning.en: "God, Grandfather, grant us this boon. Having taken three cities, we will roam this earth and this world, honored by your favor.

verses.text:
ततो वर्षसहस्रे तु समेष्यामः परस्परम् ।
एकीभावं गमिष्यन्ति पुराण्येतानि चानघ ॥

meaning.en: After a thousand years we will come together, and these cities, blameless one, will join into one.

verses.text:
समागतानि चैतानि यो हन्याद्भगवंस्तदा ।
एकेषुणा देववरः स नो मृत्युर्भविष्यति ।
एवमस्त्विति तान्देवः प्रत्युक्त्वा प्राविशद्दिवम् ॥

meaning.en: Then whichever best of the gods strikes those united cities with a single arrow, O lord, he shall be our death." The god said "So be it" to them and went into heaven.

verses.text:
ते तु लब्धवराः प्रीताः संप्रधार्य परस्परम् ।
पुरत्रयविसृष्ट्यर्थं मयं वव्रुर्महासुरम् ।
विश्वकर्माणमजरं दैत्यदानवपूजितम् ॥

meaning.en: Having won their boon, they were glad, and after consulting each other, they chose the great Asura Maya, Vishvakarman, ageless and honored by Daityas and Danavas, to make the three cities.

verses.text:
ततो मयः स्वतपसा चक्रे धीमान्पुराणि ह ।
त्रीणि काञ्चनमेकं तु रौप्यं कार्ष्णायसं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then the wise Maya by his austerity made the three cities, one of gold, one of silver and one of dark iron.

verses.text:
काञ्चनं दिवि तत्रासीदन्तरिक्षे च राजतम् ।
आयसं चाभवद्भूमौ चक्रस्थं पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: The golden city was in heaven, the silver in the sky and the iron on earth, O lord of the earth, each moving on a wheel.

verses.text:
एकैकं योजनशतं विस्तारायामसंमितम् ।
गृहाट्टाट्टालकयुतं बृहत्प्राकारतोरणम् ॥

meaning.en: Each measured a hundred yojanas in breadth and length, with houses, watchtowers and turrets, great walls and gates.

verses.text:
गुणप्रसवसंबाधमसंबाधमनामयम् ।
प्रासादैर्विविधैश्चैव द्वारैश्चाप्युपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: They were crowded with good things, yet uncrowded and free from sickness, adorned with many palaces and doors.

verses.text:
पुरेषु चाभवन्राजन्राजानो वै पृथक्पृथक् ।
काञ्चनं तारकाक्षस्य चित्रमासीन्महात्मनः ।
राजतं कमलाक्षस्य विद्युन्मालिन आयसम् ॥

meaning.en: In each city there was a separate king, O king: the golden city belonged to Tarakaksha, the marvelous one, the silver to Kamalaksha and the iron to Vidyunmalin.

verses.text:
त्रयस्ते दैत्यराजानस्त्रीँल्लोकानाशु तेजसा ।
आक्रम्य तस्थुर्वर्षाणां पूगान्नाम प्रजापतिः ॥

meaning.en: Those three Daitya kings quickly overran the three worlds by their power and stayed for the span of many years that Prajapati had named.

verses.text:
तेषां दानवमुख्यानां प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च ।
कोट्यश्चाप्रतिवीराणां समाजग्मुस्ततस्ततः ।
महदैश्वर्यमिच्छन्तस्त्रिपुरं दुर्गमाश्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: Tens of lakhs, hundreds of millions and crores of matchless chief Danavas gathered there from all around, wishing for great lordship and taking shelter in the stronghold of the three cities.

verses.text:
सर्वेषां च पुनस्तेषां सर्वयोगवहो मयः ।
तमाश्रित्य हि ते सर्वे अवर्तन्ताकुतोभयाः ॥

meaning.en: Maya was the one who accomplished every need for all of them. Relying on him, they all lived without fear from any quarter.

verses.text:
यो हि यं मनसा कामं दध्यौ त्रिपुरसंश्रयः ।
तस्मै कामं मयस्तं तं विदधे मायया तदा ॥

meaning.en: Whatever desire anyone living in the three cities held in mind, Maya, by his magic, then supplied that desire.

verses.text:
तारकाक्षसुतश्चासीद्धरिर्नाम महाबलः ।
तपस्तेपे परमकं येनातुष्यत्पितामहः ॥

meaning.en: Tarakaksha had a very strong son named Hari, who practiced supreme austerity by which the Grandfather was satisfied.

verses.text:
स तुष्टमवृणोद्देवं वापी भवतु नः पुरे ।
शस्त्रैर्विनिहता यत्र क्षिप्ताः स्युर्बलवत्तराः ॥

meaning.en: He asked the pleased god, "Let there be a pool in our city, in which those struck down by weapons and thrown in may become stronger."

verses.text:
स तु लब्ध्वा वरं वीरस्तारकाक्षसुतो हरिः ।
ससृजे तत्र वापीं तां मृतानां जीवनीं प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Having received that boon, the hero Hari, Tarakaksha's son, made there a pool that gave life to the dead, O lord.

verses.text:
येन रूपेण दैत्यस्तु येन वेषेण चैव ह ।
मृतस्तस्यां परिक्षिप्तस्तादृशेनैव जज्ञिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Any Daitya who died and was cast into it came back to life in exactly the same form and dress.

verses.text:
तां प्राप्य त्रैपुरस्थास्तु सर्वाँल्लोकान्बबाधिरे ।
महता तपसा सिद्धाः सुराणां भयवर्धनाः ।
न तेषामभवद्राजन्क्षयो युद्धे कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Having got it, those living in the Tripura oppressed all the worlds. Accomplished through great austerity, they increased the gods' fear, and, O king, they suffered no loss in battle in any way.

verses.text:
ततस्ते लोभमोहाभ्यामभिभूता विचेतसः ।
निर्ह्रीकाः संस्थितिं सर्वे स्थापितां समलूलुपन् ॥

meaning.en: Then, overcome by greed and delusion, senseless and shameless, they all broke the order that had been set.

verses.text:
विद्राव्य सगणान्देवांस्तत्र तत्र तदा तदा ।
विचेरुः स्वेन कामेन वरदानेन दर्पिताः ॥

meaning.en: Having scattered the gods with their hosts here and there from time to time, they roamed at will, proud of their boon.

verses.text:
देवारण्यानि सर्वाणि प्रियाणि च दिवौकसाम् ।
ऋषीणामाश्रमान्पुण्यान्यूपाञ्जनपदांस्तथा ।
व्यनाशयन्त मर्यादा दानवा दुष्टचारिणः ॥

meaning.en: The wicked-acting Danavas destroyed all the gods' forests, the dear places of the heaven-dwellers, the holy hermitages of sages, the sacrificial posts and the lands, breaking all limits.

verses.text:
ते देवाः सहिताः सर्वे पितामहमरिंदम ।
अभिजग्मुस्तदाख्यातुं विप्रकारं सुरेतरैः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the gods together went to the Grandfather, O subduer of foes, to tell him of the wrong done by the Asuras.

verses.text:
ते तत्त्वं सर्वमाख्याय शिरसाभिप्रणम्य च ।
वधोपायमपृच्छन्त भगवन्तं पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: They told him everything as it was, bowed their heads and asked the blessed Grandfather for a way to kill them.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा तद्भगवान्देवो देवानिदमुवाच ह ।
असुराश्च दुरात्मानस्ते चापि विबुधद्विषः ।
अपराध्यन्ति सततं ये युष्मान्पीडयन्त्युत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that, the blessed god said to the gods: "The Asuras are evil-minded and enemies of the gods. They keep offending those who torment you.

verses.text:
अहं हि तुल्यः सर्वेषां भूतानां नात्र संशयः ।
अधार्मिकास्तु हन्तव्या इत्यहं प्रब्रवीमि वः ॥

meaning.en: I am equal to all beings, without doubt, but I tell you the unrighteous must be killed.

verses.text:
ते यूयं स्थाणुमीशानं जिष्णुमक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।
योद्धारं वृणुतादित्याः स तान्हन्ता सुरेतरान् ॥

meaning.en: So choose Sthanu, Ishana, the victorious one who does his work without strain, as your fighter, O Adityas. He will kill those enemies of the gods."

verses.text:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ।
ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा वृषाङ्कं शरणं ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, the gods led by Shakra put Brahma in front and went for refuge to the Bull-bannered one.

verses.text:
तपः परं समातस्थुर्गृणन्तो ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् ।
ऋषिभिः सह धर्मज्ञा भवं सर्वात्मना गताः ॥

meaning.en: They practiced supreme austerity, chanting the eternal Brahman, and the dharma-knowing ones together with the sages went to Bhava with their whole selves.

verses.text:
तुष्टुवुर्वाग्भिरर्थ्याभिर्भयेष्वभयकृत्तमम् ।
सर्वात्मानं महात्मानं येनाप्तं सर्वमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: They praised with meaningful words the greatest giver of fearlessness in times of fear, the Self of all, the great soul, by whom all is encompassed with his own self,

verses.text:
तपोविशेषैर्बहुभिर्योगं यो वेद चात्मनः ।
यः सांख्यमात्मनो वेद यस्य चात्मा वशे सदा ॥

meaning.en: who knows yoga of the self through many special austerities, who knows Sankhya of the self, and whose self is always under his control.

verses.text:
ते तं ददृशुरीशानं तेजोराशिमुमापतिम् ।
अनन्यसदृशं लोके व्रतवन्तमकल्मषम् ॥

meaning.en: They saw that Ishana, a mass of radiance, the lord of Uma, without equal in the world, vowed and free of stain.

verses.text:
एकं च भगवन्तं ते नानारूपमकल्पयन् ।
आत्मनः प्रतिरूपाणि रूपाण्यथ महात्मनि ।
परस्परस्य चापश्यन्सर्वे परमविस्मिताः ॥

meaning.en: They imagined that one blessed lord in many forms, and in that great soul they saw forms that mirrored themselves, and saw one another's in him, all greatly amazed.

verses.text:
सर्वभूतमयं चेशं तमजं जगतः पतिम् ।
देवा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव शिरोभिर्धरणीं गताः ॥

meaning.en: The gods and the Brahmin sages, bowing their heads to the earth, worshiped him who is in all beings, the unborn, the lord of the world.

verses.text:
तान्स्वस्तिवाक्येनाभ्यर्च्य समुत्थाप्य च शंकरः ।
ब्रूत ब्रूतेति भगवान्स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Shankara honored them with words of blessing, raised them up and said, smiling, "Speak, speak!"

verses.text:
त्र्यम्बकेणाभ्यनुज्ञातास्ततस्तेऽस्वस्थचेतसः ।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु विभो तत इत्यब्रुवन्भवम् ॥

meaning.en: Permitted by Tryambaka, but with minds still troubled, they said to Bhava, "Homage, homage to you, lord!"

verses.text:
नमो देवातिदेवाय धन्विने चातिमन्यवे ।
प्रजापतिमखघ्नाय प्रजापतिभिरीड्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "Homage to the god above gods, the bearer of the bow, the very wrathful, the destroyer of Prajapati's sacrifice, who are praised by the Prajapatis.

verses.text:
नमः स्तुताय स्तुत्याय स्तूयमानाय मृत्यवे ।
विलोहिताय रुद्राय नीलग्रीवाय शूलिने ॥

meaning.en: Homage to the praised, the one to be praised, the one being praised, to death itself, to the deep red one, to Rudra, the blue-throated, the trident-bearer.

verses.text:
अमोघाय मृगाक्षाय प्रवरायुधयोधिने ।
दुर्वारणाय शुक्राय ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मचारिणे ॥

meaning.en: To the unfailing, the deer-eyed, the fighter with the best weapons, the one hard to hold back, the pure, the Brahman, the celibate.

verses.text:
ईशानायाप्रमेयाय नियन्त्रे चर्मवाससे ।
तपोनित्याय पिङ्गाय व्रतिने कृत्तिवाससे ॥

meaning.en: To Ishana, the immeasurable, the controller, wearing skins, ever in austerity, the tawny one, the vowed, clad in hide.

verses.text:
कुमारपित्रे त्र्यक्षाय प्रवरायुधधारिणे ।
प्रपन्नार्तिविनाशाय ब्रह्मद्विट्संघघातिने ॥

meaning.en: To the father of Kumara, the three-eyed, the bearer of the best weapons, the destroyer of the sorrow of those who take refuge, the slayer of throngs of enemies of Brahmins.

verses.text:
वनस्पतीनां पतये नराणां पतये नमः ।
गवां च पतये नित्यं यज्ञानां पतये नमः ॥

meaning.en: Homage to the lord of trees, the lord of men, ever the lord of cattle and the lord of sacrifices.

verses.text:
नमोऽस्तु ते ससैन्याय त्र्यम्बकायोग्रतेजसे ।
मनोवाक्कर्मभिर्देव त्वां प्रपन्नान्भजस्व नः ॥

meaning.en: Homage to you with your army, Tryambaka, of fierce radiance. Accept us, god, who have come to you for refuge in mind, speech and action."

verses.text:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्य तान् ।
प्रोवाच व्येतु वस्त्रासो ब्रूत किं करवाणि वः ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed one, pleased, welcomed them with a greeting and said, "Let your fear go. Tell me what I can do for you."

verses.text:
पितृदेवर्षिसंघेभ्यो वरे दत्ते महात्मना ।
सत्कृत्य शंकरं प्राह ब्रह्मा लोकहितं वचः ॥

meaning.en: When the great soul had granted a boon to the groups of ancestors, gods and sages, Brahma honored Shankara and spoke words for the good of the world.

verses.text:
तवातिसर्गाद्देवेश प्राजापत्यमिदं पदम् ।
मयाधितिष्ठता दत्तो दानवेभ्यो महान्वरः ॥

meaning.en: "By your release, lord of gods, I hold this office of Prajapati and have given a great boon to the Danavas.

verses.text:
तानतिक्रान्तमर्यादान्नान्यः संहर्तुमर्हति ।
त्वामृते भूतभव्येश त्वं ह्येषां प्रत्यरिर्वधे ॥

meaning.en: No one else but you, lord of past and future, can destroy them now that they have crossed the limits. You are their adversary for their killing.

verses.text:
स त्वं देव प्रपन्नानां याचतां च दिवौकसाम् ।
कुरु प्रसादं देवेश दानवाञ्जहि शूलभृत् ॥

meaning.en: So, god, show favor to those who have come to you for refuge and who beg, the heaven-dwellers. Kill the Danavas, lord of gods, bearer of the trident."

verses.text: श्रीभगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The blessed Lord said:

verses.text:
हन्तव्याः शत्रवः सर्वे युष्माकमिति मे मतिः ।
न त्वेकोऽहं वधे तेषां समर्थो वै सुरद्विषाम् ॥

meaning.en: "My view is that all your enemies must be killed, but I alone am not able to kill those enemies of the gods.

verses.text:
ते यूयं सहिताः सर्वे मदीयेनास्त्रतेजसा ।
जयध्वं युधि ताञ्शत्रून्संघातो हि महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: So all of you together, with the power of my weapon, conquer those enemies in battle, for a united force is greatly strong."

verses.text: देवा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The gods said:

verses.text:
अस्मत्तेजोबलं यावत्तावद्द्विगुणमेव च ।
तेषामिति ह मन्यामो दृष्टतेजोबला हि ते ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever the power and strength we have, they have twice as much, we think, for we have seen their power and strength."

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The Lord said:

verses.text:
वध्यास्ते सर्वतः पापा ये युष्मास्वपराधिनः ।
मम तेजोबलार्धेन सर्वांस्तान्घ्नत शात्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: "Those sinners who offend against you must be killed everywhere. With half of my power and strength, kill all those enemies."

verses.text: देवा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The gods said:

verses.text:
बिभर्तुं तेजसोऽर्धं ते न शक्ष्यामो महेश्वर ।
सर्वेषां नो बलार्धेन त्वमेव जहि शात्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: "We will not be able to bear half of your power, Maheshwara. With half of the strength of all of us, you yourself kill the enemies."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
ततस्तथेति देवेशस्तैरुक्तो राजसत्तम ।
अर्धमादाय सर्वेभ्यस्तेजसाभ्यधिकोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, best of kings, the lord of the gods said "So be it" to them, took half from all and became greater in power than all.

verses.text:
स तु देवो बलेनासीत्सर्वेभ्यो बलवत्तरः ।
महादेव इति ख्यातस्तदाप्रभृति शंकरः ॥

meaning.en: That god became stronger in might than all, and from then on Shankara was known as Mahadeva.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रवीन्महादेवो धनुर्बाणधरस्त्वहम् ।
हनिष्यामि रथेनाजौ तान्रिपून्वै दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: Then Mahadeva said, "I will carry bow and arrows, and I will kill those enemies in battle from a chariot, heaven-dwellers.

verses.text:
ते यूयं मे रथं चैव धनुर्बाणं तथैव च ।
पश्यध्वं यावदद्यैतान्पातयामि महीतले ॥

meaning.en: So make for me a chariot, a bow and arrows, and watch until today I strike them down on the ground."

verses.text: देवा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The gods said:

verses.text:
मूर्तिसर्वस्वमादाय त्रैलोक्यस्य ततस्ततः ।
रथं ते कल्पयिष्याम देवेश्वर महौजसम् ॥

meaning.en: "Taking the whole essence in form from the three worlds, here and there, we will make for you, lord of gods, a chariot of great splendor."

verses.text:
तथैव बुद्ध्या विहितं विश्वकर्मकृतं शुभम् ।
ततो विबुधशार्दूलास्तं रथं समकल्पयन् ॥

meaning.en: Then, as devised in thought, a beautiful chariot made by Vishvakarman was arranged by those tigers among the gods.

verses.text:
वन्धुरं पृथिवीं देवीं विशालपुरमालिनीम् ।
सपर्वतवनद्वीपां चक्रुर्भूतधरां तदा ॥

meaning.en: They made the goddess Earth into the chariot's body, adorned with large city garlands, with her mountains, forests and islands, as the bearer of beings.

verses.text:
मन्दरं पर्वतं चाक्षं जङ्घास्तस्य महानदीः ।
दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव परिवारं रथस्य हि ॥

meaning.en: Mount Mandara became the axle, the great rivers its thighs, and the directions and intermediate directions its retinue.

verses.text:
अनुकर्षान्ग्रहान्दीप्तान्वरूथं चापि तारकाः ।
धर्मार्थकामसंयुक्तं त्रिवेणुं चापि बन्धुरम् ।
ओषधीर्विविधास्तत्र नानापुष्पफलोद्गमाः ॥

meaning.en: The planets blazing were the underframe, the stars the cover, the triple pole joined with dharma, wealth and desire its curved frame, and many herbs with flowers and fruits of many kinds were there.

verses.text:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ कृत्वा चक्रे रथवरोत्तमे ।
पक्षौ पूर्वापरौ तत्र कृते रात्र्यहनी शुभे ॥

meaning.en: Making the sun and the moon the two wheels of that best of chariots, they made the east and west sides, and day and night were beautiful.

verses.text:
दश नागपतीनीषां धृतराष्ट्रमुखान्दृढाम् ।
द्यां युगं युगचर्माणि संवर्तकबलाहकान् ॥

meaning.en: Ten lords of the serpents, led by Dhritarashtra, were made the strong pole; the sky was the yoke, and the Samvartaka clouds were the yoke-coverings.

verses.text:
शम्यां धृतिं च मेधां च स्थितिं संनतिमेव च ।
ग्रहनक्षत्रताराभिश्चर्म चित्रं नभस्तलम् ॥

meaning.en: Calm, steadiness, wisdom, stability and humility were the yoke-pin and fittings, and the covering of the chariot was the colorful sky with planets, constellations and stars.

verses.text:
सुराम्बुप्रेतवित्तानां पतीँल्लोकेश्वरान्हयान् ।
सिनीवालीमनुमतिं कुहूं राकां च सुव्रताम् ।
योक्त्राणि चक्रुर्वाहानां रोहकांश्चापि कण्ठकम् ॥

meaning.en: They made the horses the world-guardians, the lords of the gods, the waters, the dead and wealth. They made the yoke-straps of Sinivali, Anumati, Kuhu and the firm-vowed Raka, and also the girth-pieces and neck-bands.

verses.text:
कर्म सत्यं तपोऽर्थश्च विहितास्तत्र रश्मयः ।
अधिष्ठानं मनस्त्वासीत्परिरथ्यं सरस्वती ॥

meaning.en: Action, truth, austerity and wealth were set as the reins. The mind was the chariot's seat, and Sarasvati the track around it.

verses.text:
नानावर्णाश्च चित्राश्च पताकाः पवनेरिताः ।
विद्युदिन्द्रधनुर्नद्धं रथं दीप्तं व्यदीपयत् ॥

meaning.en: Banners of many colors, blown by the wind, and lightning and Indra's rainbow bound to the chariot made it shine.

verses.text:
एवं तस्मिन्महाराज कल्पिते रथसत्तमे ।
देवैर्मनुजशार्दूल द्विषतामभिमर्दने ॥

meaning.en: So, O great king, tiger among men, when that best of chariots was made by the gods for crushing the enemies,

verses.text:
स्वान्यायुधानि मुख्यानि न्यदधाच्छंकरो रथे ।
रथयष्टिं वियत्कृष्टां स्थापयामास गोवृषम् ॥

meaning.en: Shankara laid his own best weapons in the chariot and set the Bull in place as the chariot's staff, drawn out across the sky.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मदण्डः कालदण्डो रुद्रदण्डस्तथा ज्वरः ।
परिस्कन्दा रथस्यास्य सर्वतोदिशमुद्यताः ॥

meaning.en: The staff of Brahma, the staff of Time, the staff of Rudra and Fever were set around that chariot, raised up in every direction.

verses.text:
अथर्वाङ्गिरसावास्तां चक्ररक्षौ महात्मनः ।
ऋग्वेदः सामवेदश्च पुराणं च पुरःसराः ॥

meaning.en: Atharvan and Angiras became the great soul's wheel-guards, and the Rigveda, Samaveda and Purana went in front.

verses.text:
इतिहासयजुर्वेदौ पृष्ठरक्षौ बभूवतुः ।
दिव्या वाचश्च विद्याश्च परिपार्श्वचराः कृताः ॥

meaning.en: History and the Yajurveda became the guards at the back, and divine speech and the sciences were made to go along its sides.

verses.text:
तोत्त्रादयश्च राजेन्द्र वषट्कारस्तथैव च ।
ओंकारश्च मुखे राजन्नतिशोभाकरोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The whips and the like, O king, and the vashat call, and the Om at the front, O king, made it very beautiful.

verses.text:
विचित्रमृतुभिः षड्भिः कृत्वा संवत्सरं धनुः ।
तस्मान्नॄणां कालरात्रिर्ज्या कृता धनुषोऽजरा ॥

meaning.en: Making the year the bow, varied with the six seasons, they made Night of Time, ageless, the bowstring, the Kalaratri of men.

verses.text:
इषुश्चाप्यभवद्विष्णुर्ज्वलनः सोम एव च ।
अग्नीषोमौ जगत्कृत्स्नं वैष्णवं चोच्यते जगत् ॥

meaning.en: The arrow became Vishnu, with Agni and Soma; Agni and Soma together are the whole world, and the world is said to belong to Vishnu.

verses.text:
विष्णुश्चात्मा भगवतो भवस्यामिततेजसः ।
तस्माद्धनुर्ज्यासंस्पर्शं न विषेहुर्हरस्य ते ॥

meaning.en: And Vishnu is the self of the blessed Bhava of immeasurable radiance. Therefore the gods could not bear the touch of Hara's bowstring.

verses.text:
तस्मिञ्शरे तिग्ममन्युर्मुमोचाविषहं प्रभुः ।
भृग्वङ्गिरोमन्युभवं क्रोधाग्निमतिदुःसहम् ॥

meaning.en: Into that arrow the lord of fierce wrath let loose the unbearable fire of anger, born of the wrath of Bhrigu and Angiras, hard to endure.

verses.text:
स नीललोहितो धूम्रः कृत्तिवासा भयंकरः ।
आदित्यायुतसंकाशस्तेजोज्वालावृतो ज्वलन् ॥

meaning.en: He was dark blue and red, smoky, wearing hide, fearsome, like ten thousand suns, blazing, wrapped in flames of splendor.

verses.text:
दुश्च्यावश्च्यावनो जेता हन्ता ब्रह्मद्विषां हरः ।
नित्यं त्राता च हन्ता च धर्माधर्माश्रिताञ्जनान् ॥

meaning.en: Hara, hard to dislodge but dislodging others, the conqueror, the slayer of enemies of Brahmins, ever the protector and ever the slayer of men who rest on dharma and adharma,

verses.text:
प्रमाथिभिर्घोररूपैर्भीमोदग्रैर्गणैर्वृतः ।
विभाति भगवान्स्थाणुस्तैरेवात्मगुणैर्वृतः ॥

meaning.en: surrounded by his terrible Pramathas, fearsome and fierce hosts, the blessed Sthanu shone, wrapped by those very qualities of his own.

verses.text:
तस्याङ्गानि समाश्रित्य स्थितं विश्वमिदं जगत् ।
जङ्गमाजङ्गमं राजञ्शुशुभेऽद्भुतदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: This whole world, moving and unmoving, rested on his limbs and shone, a wondrous sight, O king.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा तु तं रथं दिव्यं कवची स शरासनी ।
बाणमादत्त तं दिव्यं सोमविष्ण्वग्निसंभवम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that divine chariot, he put on armor, took his bow, and took up that divine arrow born of Soma, Vishnu and Agni.

verses.text:
तस्य वाजांस्ततो देवाः कल्पयां चक्रिरे विभोः ।
पुण्यगन्धवहं राजञ्श्वसनं राजसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods made the lord's horses, the fragrant wind itself, O king, best of kings.

verses.text:
तमास्थाय महादेवस्त्रासयन्दैवतान्यपि ।
आरुरोह तदा यत्तः कम्पयन्निव रोदसी ॥

meaning.en: Mounting it, Mahadeva, frightening even the gods, climbed up intently, almost making heaven and earth tremble.

verses.text:
स शोभमानो वरदः खड्गी बाणी शरासनी ।
हसन्निवाब्रवीद्देवो सारथिः को भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Shining, the boon-giver, with sword, arrow and bow, the god said, almost laughing, "Who will be my charioteer?"

verses.text:
तमब्रुवन्देवगणा यं भवान्संनियोक्ष्यते ।
स भविष्यति देवेश सारथिस्ते न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: The hosts of gods said to him, "Whoever you appoint, lord of gods, he will be your charioteer, without doubt."

verses.text:
तानब्रवीत्पुनर्देवो मत्तः श्रेष्ठतरो हि यः ।
तं सारथिं कुरुध्वं मे स्वयं संचिन्त्य माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: The god said to them again, "Whoever is better than I, make him my charioteer. Think it over yourselves, quickly."

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततो देवा वाक्यमुक्तं महात्मना ।
गत्वा पितामहं देवं प्रसाद्यैवं वचोऽब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words spoken by the great soul, the gods went to the Grandfather, pleased him and said:

verses.text:
देव त्वयेदं कथितं त्रिदशारिनिबर्हणम् ।
तथा च कृतमस्माभिः प्रसन्नो वृषभध्वजः ॥

meaning.en: "God, you told us of this means to destroy the enemies of the gods. We have done so, and the Bull-bannered one is pleased.

verses.text:
रथश्च विहितोऽस्माभिर्विचित्रायुधसंवृतः ।
सारथिं तु न जानीमः कः स्यात्तस्मिन्रथोत्तमे ॥

meaning.en: A chariot has been made by us, covered with weapons of many kinds, but we do not know who is to be the charioteer in that best of chariots.

verses.text:
तस्माद्विधीयतां कश्चित्सारथिर्देवसत्तम ।
सफलां तां गिरं देव कर्तुमर्हसि नो विभो ॥

meaning.en: So let a charioteer be appointed, best of gods. You should make that word of yours fulfilled, lord.

verses.text:
एवमस्मासु हि पुरा भगवन्नुक्तवानसि ।
हितं कर्तास्मि भवतामिति तत्कर्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: You said this to us before, blessed one, 'I will do what is good for you.' You should do that.

verses.text:
स देव युक्तो रथसत्तमो नो
दुरावरो द्रावणः शात्रवाणाम् ।
पिनाकपाणिर्विहितोऽत्र योद्धा
विभीषयन्दानवानुद्यतोऽसौ ॥

meaning.en: "This best of chariots is ready, god, hard to withstand, driving off enemies; the warrior who holds Pinaka in his hand has been set here, ready to terrify the Danavas.

verses.text:
तथैव वेदाश्चतुरो हयाग्र्या
धरा सशैला च रथो महात्मन् ।
नक्षत्रवंशोऽनुगतो वरूथे
यस्मिन्योद्धा सारथिनाभिरक्ष्यः ॥

meaning.en: The four Vedas are the best horses, and the earth with her mountains is the chariot, great soul, with the line of the constellations attending its cover, and in it the warrior must be guarded by the charioteer.

verses.text:
तत्र सारथिरेष्टव्यः सर्वैरेतैर्विशेषवान् ।
तत्प्रतिष्ठो रथो देव हया योद्धा तथैव च ।
कवचानि च शस्त्राणि कार्मुकं च पितामह ॥

meaning.en: So a charioteer must be sought who is distinguished beyond all these. The chariot depends on him, god, and the horses and the warrior, and the armor, weapons and bow, Grandfather.

verses.text:
त्वामृते सारथिं तत्र नान्यं पश्यामहे वयम् ।
त्वं हि सर्वैर्गुणैर्युक्तो देवताभ्योऽधिकः प्रभो ।
सारथ्ये तूर्णमारोह संयच्छ परमान्हयान् ॥

meaning.en: We see no other charioteer there but you. You are endowed with all qualities, lord, greater than the gods. Quickly mount as charioteer and hold the best horses."

verses.text:
इति ते शिरसा नत्वा त्रिलोकेशं पितामहम् ।
देवाः प्रसादयामासुः सारथ्यायेति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: So, bowing their heads to the Grandfather, lord of the three worlds, the gods pleased him to be the charioteer, we have heard.

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
नात्र किंचिन्मृषा वाक्यं यदुक्तं वो दिवौकसः ।
संयच्छामि हयानेष युध्यतो वै कपर्दिनः ॥

meaning.en: "There is nothing false in what you have said, heaven-dwellers. I will hold the horses for him as the Matted-hair one fights."

verses.text:
ततः स भगवान्देवो लोकस्रष्टा पितामहः ।
सारथ्ये कल्पितो देवैरीशानस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed god, the Grandfather, creator of the worlds, was made charioteer by the gods for the great soul Ishana.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्नारोहति क्षिप्रं स्यन्दनं लोकपूजिते ।
शिरोभिरगमंस्तूर्णं ते हया वातरंहसः ॥

meaning.en: When he quickly climbed into that chariot honored by the world, the horses, swift as the wind, bowed with their heads to the ground.

verses.text: महेश्वरे त्वारुहति जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम् ॥

meaning.en: When Maheshwara climbed up, they went down to the earth on their knees.

verses.text:
अभीशून्हि त्रिलोकेशः संगृह्य प्रपितामहः ।
तानश्वांश्चोदयामास मनोमारुतरंहसः ॥

meaning.en: The Great-grandfather, lord of the three worlds, took the reins and urged on those horses, swift as mind and wind.

verses.text:
ततोऽधिरूढे वरदे प्रयाते चासुरान्प्रति ।
साधु साध्विति विश्वेशः स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Then, when the boon-giver had mounted and set out toward the Asuras, the lord of the universe, smiling, said "Well done, well done!"

verses.text:
याहि देव यतो दैत्याश्चोदयाश्वानतन्द्रितः ।
पश्य बाह्वोर्बलं मेऽद्य निघ्नतः शात्रवान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: "Go, god, where the Daityas are, drive the horses without tiring. See today the strength of my arms as I strike down enemies in battle."

verses.text:
ततस्तांश्चोदयामास वायुवेगसमाञ्जवे ।
येन तत्त्रिपुरं राजन्दैत्यदानवरक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he urged the horses, swift as the wind, toward that city of the three, O king, guarded by Daityas and Danavas.

verses.text:
अथाधिज्यं धनुः कृत्वा शर्वः संधाय तं शरम् ।
युक्त्वा पाशुपतास्त्रेण त्रिपुरं समचिन्तयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Sharva strung the bow, fitted that arrow, joined it with the Pashupata weapon and fixed his mind on the Tripura.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्स्थिते तदा राजन्क्रुद्धे विधृतकार्मुके ।
पुराणि तानि कालेन जग्मुरेकत्वतां तदा ॥

meaning.en: As he stood there, O king, angry, with bow drawn, the three cities in time came together into one.

verses.text:
एकीभावं गते चैव त्रिपुरे समुपागते ।
बभूव तुमुलो हर्षो दैवतानां महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: When the Tripura had come together into one, a tumultuous joy arose among the great-souled gods.

verses.text:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।
जयेति वाचो मुमुचुः संस्तुवन्तो मुदान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the hosts of gods, the Siddhas and the great sages, filled with delight, cried "Victory!" and praised him.

verses.text:
ततोऽग्रतः प्रादुरभूत्त्रिपुरं जघ्नुषोऽसुरान् ।
अनिर्देश्योग्रवपुषो देवस्यासह्यतेजसः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Tripura appeared in front of the one who was killing the Asuras, the god of unspeakable fierce form and unbearable splendor.

verses.text:
स तद्विकृष्य भगवान्दिव्यं लोकेश्वरो धनुः ।
त्रैलोक्यसारं तमिषुं मुमोच त्रिपुरं प्रति ।
तत्सासुरगणं दग्ध्वा प्राक्षिपत्पश्चिमार्णवे ॥

meaning.en: That blessed lord of the worlds drew his divine bow, loosed the arrow, the essence of the three worlds, at the Tripura, and having burned it with its host of Asuras, he cast it into the western sea.

verses.text:
एवं तत्त्रिपुरं दग्धं दानवाश्चाप्यशेषतः ।
महेश्वरेण क्रुद्धेन त्रैलोक्यस्य हितैषिणा ॥

meaning.en: So the Tripura and all the Danavas were burned without remainder by angry Maheshwara, who wished the good of the three worlds.

verses.text:
स चात्मक्रोधजो वह्निर्हाहेत्युक्त्वा निवारितः ।
मा कार्षीर्भस्मसाल्लोकानिति त्र्यक्षोऽब्रवीच्च तम् ॥

meaning.en: The fire born of his anger was stopped with a cry of "Alas!", and the three-eyed one said to it, "Do not reduce the worlds to ashes."

verses.text:
ततः प्रकृतिमापन्ना देवा लोकास्तथर्षयः ।
तुष्टुवुर्वाग्भिरर्थ्याभिः स्थाणुमप्रतिमौजसम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods, the worlds and the sages, restored to their natural state, praised Sthanu of matchless might with meaningful words.

verses.text:
तेऽनुज्ञाता भगवता जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम् ।
कृतकामाः प्रसन्नेन प्रजापतिमुखाः सुराः ॥

meaning.en: With the blessed one's leave they all went as they had come, the gods led by Prajapati having got their wishes from the gracious one.

verses.text:
यथैव भगवान्ब्रह्मा लोकधाता पितामहः ।
संयच्छ त्वं हयानस्य राधेयस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: As the blessed Brahma, the Grandfather, supporter of the worlds, did there, so you hold the horses of this great-souled son of Radha.

verses.text:
त्वं हि कृष्णाच्च कर्णाच्च फल्गुनाच्च विशेषतः ।
विशिष्टो राजशार्दूल नास्ति तत्र विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: For you are superior to Krishna, to Karna and especially to Phalguna, O tiger among kings. There is no doubt about that.

verses.text:
युद्धे ह्ययं रुद्रकल्पस्त्वं च ब्रह्मसमोऽनघ ।
तस्माच्छक्तौ युवां जेतुं मच्छत्रूंस्ताविवासुरान् ॥

meaning.en: In battle Karna is like Rudra and you are equal to Brahma, blameless one. Therefore you two can conquer my enemies as those two conquered the Asuras.

verses.text:
यथा शल्याद्य कर्णोऽयं श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम् ।
प्रमथ्य हन्यात्कौन्तेयं तथा शीघ्रं विधीयताम् ।
त्वयि कर्णश्च राज्यं च वयं चैव प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥

meaning.en: As Karna today, Shalya, should crush and kill the son of Kunti, the white-horsed one with Krishna as charioteer, so let it be arranged quickly. Karna, the kingdom and we ourselves rest upon you.

verses.text:
इमं चाप्यपरं भूय इतिहासं निबोध मे ।
पितुर्मम सकाशे यं ब्राह्मणः प्राह धर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: Hear from me another story, which a Brahmin who knew dharma told in my father's presence.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा चैतद्वचश्चित्रं हेतुकार्यार्थसंहितम् ।
कुरु शल्य विनिश्चित्य मा भूदत्र विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: Having heard this wondrous account, full of reasons and purposes, act on it, Shalya, once you have decided. Let there be no hesitation here.

verses.text:
भार्गवाणां कुले जातो जमदग्निर्महातपाः ।
तस्य रामेति विख्यातः पुत्रस्तेजोगुणान्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Born in the family of the Bhargavas was Jamadagni, of great austerity. His son, called Rama, was endowed with splendor and virtues.

verses.text:
स तीव्रं तप आस्थाय प्रसादयितवान्भवम् ।
अस्त्रहेतोः प्रसन्नात्मा नियतः संयतेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: Taking up severe austerity, he pleased Bhava for the sake of weapons, with a calm mind, disciplined and with his senses restrained.

verses.text:
तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो भक्त्या च प्रशमेन च ।
हृद्गतं चास्य विज्ञाय दर्शयामास शंकरः ॥

meaning.en: Mahadeva was pleased with him for his devotion and calm. Knowing what was in his heart, Shankara showed himself to him.

verses.text: ईश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Ishvara said:

verses.text:
राम तुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते विदितं मे तवेप्सितम् ।
कुरुष्व पूतमात्मानं सर्वमेतदवाप्स्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "Rama, I am pleased. May it go well with you. I know what you desire. Make yourself pure, and you will gain all this.

verses.text:
दास्यामि ते तदास्त्राणि यदा पूतो भविष्यसि ।
अपात्रमसमर्थं च दहन्त्यस्त्राणि भार्गव ॥

meaning.en: I will give you the weapons when you are pure. Weapons burn one who is unworthy and unable, Bhargava."

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो जामदग्न्यस्तु देवदेवेन शूलिना ।
प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं शिरसावनतः प्रभुम् ॥

meaning.en: Told so by the god of gods, the trident-bearer, Jamadagni's son bowed his head and answered that great lord.

verses.text:
यदा जानासि देवेश पात्रं मामस्त्रधारणे ।
तदा शुश्रूषतेऽस्त्राणि भवान्मे दातुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: "Lord of the gods, when you know me to be a fit vessel for holding weapons, then you should give me the weapons, since I wish to serve."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
ततः स तपसा चैव दमेन नियमेन च ।
पूजोपहारबलिभिर्होममन्त्रपुरस्कृतैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, with austerity, self-control and discipline, with worship, offerings and oblations, led by fire-offerings and mantras,

verses.text:
आराधयितवाञ्शर्वं बहून्वर्षगणांस्तदा ।
प्रसन्नश्च महादेवो भार्गवस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: he propitiated Sharva for many years, and Mahadeva became pleased with the great-souled Bhargava.

verses.text:
अब्रवीत्तस्य बहुशो गुणान्देव्याः समीपतः ।
भक्तिमानेष सततं मयि रामो दृढव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: Many times in the presence of the goddess he spoke of his virtues: "This Rama is always devoted to me, firm in his vows."

verses.text:
एवं तस्य गुणान्प्रीतो बहुशोऽकथयत्प्रभुः ।
देवतानां पितॄणां च समक्षमरिसूदनः ॥

meaning.en: Pleased, the lord, slayer of enemies, told of his virtues many times in front of the gods and the ancestors.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दैत्या आसन्महाबलाः ।
तैस्तदा दर्पमोहान्धैरबाध्यन्त दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: At that very time there were very powerful Daityas, and the heaven-dwellers were tormented by them, blinded by pride and delusion.

verses.text:
ततः संभूय विबुधास्तान्हन्तुं कृतनिश्चयाः ।
चक्रुः शत्रुवधे यत्नं न शेकुर्जेतुमेव ते ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods gathered and resolved to kill them and made an effort to destroy the enemy, but could not conquer them.

verses.text:
अभिगम्य ततो देवा महेश्वरमथाब्रुवन् ।
प्रसादयन्तस्तं भक्त्या जहि शत्रुगणानिति ॥

meaning.en: The gods then went to Maheshwara and, pleasing him with devotion, said, "Kill the hosts of enemies."

verses.text:
प्रतिज्ञाय ततो देवो देवतानां रिपुक्षयम् ।
रामं भार्गवमाहूय सोऽभ्यभाषत शंकरः ॥

meaning.en: Having promised the gods the destruction of their foes, Shankara called Rama, the Bhargava, and said to him:

verses.text:
रिपून्भार्गव देवानां जहि सर्वान्समागतान् ।
लोकानां हितकामार्थं मत्प्रीत्यर्थं तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: "Bhargava, kill all those enemies of the gods who have gathered, for the good of the worlds and to please me."

verses.text: राम उवाच

meaning.en: Rama said:

verses.text:
अकृतास्त्रस्य देवेश का शक्तिर्मे महेश्वर ।
निहन्तुं दानवान्सर्वान्कृतास्त्रान्युद्धदुर्मदान् ॥

meaning.en: "Lord of gods, Maheshwara, what power have I, who have not mastered weapons, to kill all the Danavas, who are trained in weapons and wild in battle?"

verses.text: ईश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Ishvara said:

verses.text:
गच्छ त्वं मदनुध्यानान्निहनिष्यसि दानवान् ।
विजित्य च रिपून्सर्वान्गुणान्प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलान् ॥

meaning.en: "Go. By meditation on me you will kill the Danavas, and having conquered all your enemies you will gain abundant virtues."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा च वचनं प्रतिगृह्य च सर्वशः ।
रामः कृतस्वस्त्ययनः प्रययौ दानवान्प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these words and accepting them wholly, Rama, having had blessings spoken over him, went against the Danavas.

verses.text:
अवधीद्देवशत्रूंस्तान्मददर्पबलान्वितान् ।
वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शैः प्रहारैरेव भार्गवः ॥

meaning.en: Bhargava killed those enemies of the gods, full of arrogance and strength, with blows like thunderbolts.

verses.text:
स दानवैः क्षततनुर्जामदग्न्यो द्विजोत्तमः ।
संस्पृष्टः स्थाणुना सद्यो निर्व्रणः समजायत ॥

meaning.en: The best of Brahmins, Jamadagni's son, whose body had been wounded by the Danavas, was touched by Sthanu and at once became free of wounds.

verses.text:
प्रीतश्च भगवान्देवः कर्मणा तेन तस्य वै ।
वरान्प्रादाद्ब्रह्मविदे भार्गवाय महात्मने ॥

meaning.en: The blessed god, pleased with that deed of his, gave boons to Bhargava, the great soul who knew Brahman.

verses.text:
उक्तश्च देवदेवेन प्रीतियुक्तेन शूलिना ।
निपातात्तव शस्त्राणां शरीरे याभवद्रुजा ॥

meaning.en: The god of gods, the trident-bearer, filled with affection, said to him, "The pain you felt in your body from the fall of their weapons

verses.text:
तया ते मानुषं कर्म व्यपोढं भृगुनन्दन ।
गृहाणास्त्राणि दिव्यानि मत्सकाशाद्यथेप्सितम् ॥

meaning.en: has removed your human limitations, joy of Bhrigu. Take divine weapons from me, as you wish."

verses.text:
ततोऽस्त्राणि समस्तानि वरांश्च मनसेप्सितान् ।
लब्ध्वा बहुविधान्रामः प्रणम्य शिरसा शिवम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, having received all the weapons and the many boons he wished for in his mind, Rama bowed his head to Shiva,

verses.text:
अनुज्ञां प्राप्य देवेशाज्जगाम स महातपाः ।
एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तं तदा कथितवानृषिः ॥

meaning.en: and, getting leave from the lord of gods, the great ascetic went away. So this old event was told then by the sage.

verses.text:
भार्गवोऽप्यददात्सर्वं धनुर्वेदं महात्मने ।
कर्णाय पुरुषव्याघ्र सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना ॥

meaning.en: And Bhargava, with a very pleased heart, gave all of archery to the great soul Karna, tiger among men.

verses.text:
वृजिनं हि भवेत्किंचिद्यदि कर्णस्य पार्थिव ।
नास्मै ह्यस्त्राणि दिव्यानि प्रादास्यद्भृगुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: If there were any fault in Karna, O king, the joy of Bhrigu would not have given him the divine weapons.

verses.text:
नापि सूतकुले जातं कर्णं मन्ये कथंचन ।
देवपुत्रमहं मन्ये क्षत्रियाणां कुलोद्भवम् ॥

meaning.en: I do not at all think Karna is born in a charioteer's family. I think he is a son of a god, born in a Kshatriya line.

verses.text:
सकुण्डलं सकवचं दीर्घबाहुं महारथम् ।
कथमादित्यसदृशं मृगी व्याघ्रं जनिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: How could a doe give birth to a tiger, long-armed, great chariot-warrior, sun-like, with earrings and armor?

verses.text:
पश्य ह्यस्य भुजौ पीनौ नागराजकरोपमौ ।
वक्षः पश्य विशालं च सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् ॥

meaning.en: Look at his thick arms, like the trunks of elephant-kings. Look at his broad chest, the destroyer of all enemies.
